summary:
Implemented and exported `Perc`, with NumPy version compatibility, percentile rows, and orientation-aware grouping. Added statistics tests, API and usage documentation, and a v0.12.1 release note.

The focused tests passed (7/7). The full suite had 1,785 passed, 81 skipped, and 6 xfailed; one unrelated `FacetGrid.test_subplot_kws` assertion failed because the installed Matplotlib returns `PolarAxes` instead of `PolarAxesSubplot`. `git diff --check` and the new notebook’s JSON validation passed.

I did not build the rendered documentation.
